title: Apple reportedly planning two rounds of product launches in October
description: Last week, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman claimed that Apple will announce its new HomePad on October 13. Now, a new report suggests that the company is planning two separate product launches this month. According to the report, which cites multiple sources familiar with the matter, Apple is planning another online launch in the final week of October. The company could announce the rumored MacBook Ultra lineup, along with M6 powered 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac models. Notably, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman recently stated that Apple would unveil the touchscreen MacBooks next month. Apple is...

title: vivo S2 FE arrives with a massive 10,000mAh battery
description: After bringing its S-series back to India with the vivo S2 in August, the company has now expanded the lineup with the new vivo S2 FE. The phone features a massive 10,000mAh battery and a large 6.83 inch display. The vivo S2 FE packs the company’s largest battery at 10,000mAh, while also offering 44W fast charging and reverse charging, making it a portable powerbank as well. Other than the massive battery, the handset comes equipped with the Dimensity 7300e chipset and sports a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a refresh rate of 120Hz. It also gets an in-display fingerprint...

description: It’s the October edition of Amazon Prime Day also known as Prime Day Deals. title: vivo X Fold6 launches in India, here's how much it costs
description: Once again, a rumor turned out to be true. We're talking about the one saying that vivo would launch the X Fold6 globally on October 1 and in India on October 6. The global launch has already happened, right on that schedule, and so today you probably won’t be surprised to find out that the X Fold6 is also launched in India. The phone's specs are identical to the ones of the global version, which itself only differs from the Chinese model in the 100 mAh smaller battery. The X Fold6 is priced at INR 219,999 ($2,283) and will only be available with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of...

title: Honor Play20C is also official with a rear touchscreen
description: Alongside the X5d s, Honor is bringing a second budget phone with a rear screen – the Play20C. While different in name, the two share identical hardware, and it seems the Play20C will be the global variant of the X5d s. There is a small difference between the two, though, as the 4GB RAM and 128GB trim of the Play20C comes with a Unisoc T615 chipset at the helm, while the other trims get the Unisoc T610. Play20C also comes in a Sunrise Gold color, which isn’t available on the X5d s. Apart from that, it’s the same phone as the X5d s with a 6.78-inch IPS LCD (HD+ 90Hz), a 2-inch...

title: vivo V80 hands-on review
description: vivo hosted a grand event today in Gurgaon, India, where it unveiled the V80 and S2 FE and introduced the X Fold6 to the Indian market. We used the vivo V80 for a few days, and here's how it performed. Design The vivo V80 is built around a 6.59" 1,260p 144Hz AMOLED display, surrounded by 1.25mm bezels. The display has a centered punch-hole for a ZEISS-tuned 50MP selfie camera. The V80's display also has a 3D ultrasonic fingerprint scanner embedded, which was fast and accurate during our use. It supports swipe-based fingerprint enrollment, and we like how it's placed far from...

title: Here's when Siri AI may finally become available in the EU
description: One of the main new features of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 is the new Siri AI, but this still isn't available in the EU, despite the fact that Apple released iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 last month. Now if you've been wondering just how much longer you'll have to wait, we have some bad news. According to the generally reliable Mark Gurman at Bloomberg, we shouldn't expect Siri AI to launch in the EU "anytime soon". Apparently, Apple wants to use the lack of Siri AI in the EU to get its frustrated customers to "push back against the EU's regulatory approach". That's definitely an interesting...

title: vivo V80 debuts with a 6.59-inch display, a 7,200mAh battery
description: vivo’s latest V-series smartphone is finally here. The vivo V80 has launched in India with a 7,200mAh battery, a compact 6.59 inch display, and a Zeiss-backed triple-rear camera setup. The vivo V80 is powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset and sports a 6.59-inch AMOLED display that offers up to 144Hz refresh rate, Full-HD+ resolution, and up to 5,000 nits of peak brightness. For photography, the vivo V80 features a Zeiss triple-rear camera setup that includes a 50MP Sony LYT 700V main sensor with OIS and autofocus. It supports 4K cinematic and 4K 60fps video recording. There’s...

title: iPhone 18 Pro Burgundy paint fading issues reported by some early adopters
description: Within a couple of weeks of launching, iPhone 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max users last year started complaining online of a weird discoloration issue that affected mainly the hero Cosmic Orange color, but it was also observed on the Deep Blue paint job. Now, the iPhone 18 Pro series users are going through the same phase. iPhone 18 Pro Max in Burgundy and Black A number of Reddit users have posted pictures of Burgundy red units slowly getting pale. Some discolored Black iPhones can also be spotted among the subreddits. Just like last year, the discoloration seems to start from the area...

title: WhatsApp may prevent you from logging in if you have older iOS or Android versions
description: According to a new report, WhatsApp has added a new feature via a server-side update, which means you don't have to have a specific app version to get it. This is apparently rolling out to both Android and iOS. The idea is that WhatsApp will prevent you from logging in until you update your phone’s operating system to a newer version. So if you have an outdated version of Android or iOS, you will see a screen like the ones shown in the image below. It explains what you need to do before you can log into your WhatsApp account again. WhatsApp tells you to go to your phone's Settings...

title: Honor X5d s takes the rear screen idea to a very low price point
description: Xiaomi started a trend last year with the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max - not a huge trend, but a trend nonetheless. Other Chinese smartphone makers are now starting to get inspired by the idea of having a screen on the rear of some of their devices. And today it's Honor's turn to join the party. Ladies and gentlemen, meet the Honor X5d s. Crazy name aside, this phone has a rear screen of its own, as you can see. Unlike the Xiaomi 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max (and their successors, the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max), the Honor X5d s isn't a high-end device, however. It comes with a 6.78-inch LCD screen...

title: vivo Y32 quietly launches with an 8,000 mAh battery
description: vivo has quietly listed the Y32 on its website in Bangladesh. The phone is obviously not to be confused with the Y32 from 2021 - we're not sure why the company is reusing the name so soon (or at all, really), but it is what it is. Anyway, the new Y32 comes with a 6.87-inch LCD screen with 720x1592 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,300-nit peak brightness, a 50MP main camera, a 2MP decorative sensor of some sort (probably a depth sensor), an 8MP selfie camera, and an 8,000 mAh battery with support for 44W wired charging. vivo Y32 in both colors The phone is powered by...

title: Watch the vivo V80 announcement live here
description: After announcing the V80 Lite at the start of September, vivo started teasing the V80 with promises of a phone that can capture “cinematic moments”. The date was set for October 6, so it’s finally time to reveal the new model. vivo V80's color options The company has already confirmed some key details for the vivo V80. It will have a 6.59” 1.5K OLED display with 144Hz refresh rate and a peak brightness of 5,000 nits. The phone will be equipped with a 7,200mAh battery with 90W charging. description: After Xiaomi announced the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, it revealed that the two are headed for a global launch. That was a bit unusual, since the Xiaomi 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max never left China. Maybe this has something to do with the rumor from August that claimed that the Xiaomi 18 Ultra had been canceled. Now leakster Digital Chat Station is reporting the same – the Ultra is off the launch calendar. description: The new iPhone hit the shelves and the first order of business is to pit it against its predecessor. The Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max brings screen, performance, camera and battery improvements over the previous generation and yet the Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max gets you a lot of the same at a cheaper price. So how much better is the Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max? Let's look into it. title: OpenAI is adding visual ads to ChatGPT
description: OpenAI introduced ads for free and Go users of ChatGPT back in February. Those were pretty simple ads that appeared between chat messages. Now the company is adding a new ad format, which it calls visual ads. These feature larger images – either several thumbnails or one screen-width image. These aren’t live yet as OpenAI plans to introduce them later this month. This will start with a testing period where visual ads will only be shown when the user generates images with ChatGPT. However, the visual ads will be presented separately from the generated images and will be clearly marked as...

description: Samsung started rolling out the update to One UI 9 based on Android 17 for the Galaxy S25 family and the Galaxy Z Fold7 and Galaxy Z Flip7 in late September, and the update has made its way to the US over the weekend for the Galaxy S25 devices. description: Although Google only launched the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in August, we already have a first leak about their successors. description: Last week, Samsung hiked the prices of its high-end devices in the US (along with Europe and India), and today the company has raised the prices of its low-end and mid-range phones in the US as well. Samsung Galaxy A57 We're talking about the Galaxy A17, A27, A37, and A57. The A17 is now $270, up from $200 when it launched. The A27 now goes for $380, up from $350 when it was released.
